blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Fine-tuning large language models on parallel data improves translation quality but can cause catastrophic forgetting.
Mitigation methods are generally evaluated by retention on general benchmarks.
We ask whether these findings transfer to machine translation (MT) fine-tuning and to MT-specific instruction following (MT-IF):
instructions that modify a translation, such as formality, grammatical gender, and length control.
We compare methods anchored to auxiliary data, to model outputs, and to the base model parameters, first in a screening study with Llama 3.2 1B Instruct, then on Llama 3.1 8B Instruct fine-tuned on bidirectional Arabic-English or Spanish-English data.
Elastic Weight Consolidation preserves general capabilities best in both stages; on the 8B Spanish model the average score on general benchmarks drops 1.7 points versus 11.0 for standard fine-tuning, yet its scores for formality and grammatical gender control remain close to standard fine-tuning.
Only data mixing with control-task examples preserves these controls, but its gains do not transfer to unseen prompts for the same task.
blocks.zh:
在平行数据上精细调整大型语言模型可以提高翻译质量,但可能导致灾难性的遗忘.
缓解方法一般通过保留一般基准加以评估。
我们询问这些结果是否转移到机器翻译(MT)微调和下面的MT特定指令(MT-IF):
用于修改翻译的指令,如形式、语法性别以及长度控制。
我们首先与Llama 3.2 1B Instruct进行筛选研究,然后在Llama 3.1 8B Instruct对双向阿拉伯语-英语或西班牙语-英语数据进行微调。
弹性体重整合在两个阶段都保持了最佳的一般能力;在8B西班牙语模式下,一般基准的平均得分比标准微调的11.0比降1.7分,但其形式性和语法性别控制的得分仍然接近标准微调.
只有与控制任务实例混合的数据才能保存这些控制,但其收益不会转移给同一任务的隐形提示。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) translate well between high-resource languages ( Robinson et al., 2023 ) and can modify their translations in response to natural language instructions.
Translation quality is lower for language pairs and domains that are poorly represented in the training data. Fine-tuning on parallel data can reduce this gap. In our experiments, it raises COMET from 45.6 to 71.5 for Amharic-to-English translation.
blocks.zh:
指令调制的大语言模型(LLMs)在高资源语言之间翻译得很好(Robinson等人,2023年),并且可以根据自然语言指令修改翻译.
语文对口和在培训数据中代表性不足的领域翻译质量较低。 对平行数据的微调可以缩小这一差距。 在我们的实验中,它将彗星从45.6提高到71.5,用于阿姆哈拉语对英语的翻译.

blocks.en:
Fine-tuning on a narrow task can cause catastrophic forgetting, in which performance degrades on capabilities not represented in the fine-tuning data. One capability at risk during MT fine-tuning is following instructions that modify a translation. For example, a prompt can request a formal translation, select the masculine or feminine forms used for a person mentioned in the source, or impose a length constraint. Conventional neural machine translation (NMT) systems can support these controls, but typically require dedicated mechanisms and annotated training data.
In applications such as subtitling, the controls can be part of the translation task ( Matusov et al., 2019 ) .
blocks.zh:
对狭义任务进行微调可造成灾难性的遗忘,其中性能会降低微调数据中没有体现的能力. 在MT微调过程中面临风险的一个能力是遵循修改译文的指示. 例如,一个提示可以要求正式翻译,为来源中提到的人选择男性或女性表格,或者施加长度限制。 常规神经机译(NMT)系统可以支持这些控制,但一般需要专用机制和附加说明的培训数据.
在子titling等应用中,控件可以是翻译任务的一部分(Matusov等人,2019年).

blocks.en: Figure 1: Formality-controlled translation from CoCoA-MT ( Nadejde et al., 2022 ) before and after fine-tuning Llama 3.1 8B Instruct on 1M Spanish ↔ \leftrightarrow English sentence pairs, with each model’s COMET (translation quality, FLORES es ↔ \leftrightarrow en) and average General capabilities scores. EWC recovers most of the general-capability loss but not the instructed formality; only Data Mixing with control-task examples retains it.
blocks.zh: 图1:在对Llama 3.1 8B进行微调之前和之后由CoCoCoA-MT(Nadejde et al., 2022年)进行形式控制翻译,以1M西班牙语 \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\一般能力分数为每个型号的COMET(翻译质量,FLORES es ×\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\的翻译。 EWC回收了大部分一般能力损失,但没有指令性手续;只有Data Mixing与控制任务示例保留.

blocks.en:
A number of methods to mitigate forgetting have been proposed.
They differ in the reference signal they use to mitigate forgetting, which we call the anchor: auxiliary data that represents the capabilities to be kept, the output distribution of a model, or the parameters of the base model ( Section 3 ).
Existing evaluations fine-tune on data from domains such as mathematical reasoning and code, and measure retention with general benchmarks ( Biderman et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Diao et al., 2026 ) .
It remains unclear how well the mitigation methods transfer when MT is the fine-tuning task, and whether they protect MT-specific instruction following (MT-IF).
blocks.zh:
已经提出了一些减轻遗忘的方法。
它们使用不同的参考信号来缓解遗忘,我们称之为锚:代表要保存的能力的辅助数据,模型的输出分布,或基准模型的参数(第3节).
现有评价对来自数学推理和代码等领域的数据进行微调,并以一般基准衡量保留情况(Biderman等人,2024年;Yang等人,2024年;Diao等人,2026年)。
仍然不清楚的是,在MT是微调任务时,缓解方法的转移情况如何,以及它们是否保护MT特定指令(MT-IF)。

blocks.en:
We address these questions for instruction-tuned models in two stages.
Stage 1 is a screening study with Llama 3.2 1B Instruct, fine-tuned separately on Amharic-to-English, Arabic-to-English, and Spanish-to-English data.
We compare the mitigation methods of Section 3 across hyperparameter settings, measuring translation quality and general capabilities ( Section 4 ).
Stage 2 is the main experiment.
We apply selected configurations to Llama 3.1 8B Instruct and fine-tune it on bidirectional Arabic-English or Spanish-English data.
In addition to translation quality and general capabilities, we evaluate MT-IF on formality, grammatical gender, and length control ( Section 4.3 ).
blocks.zh:
我们分两个阶段处理这些问题,以指导性模式。
第一阶段是与Llama 3.2 1B Instruct进行筛选研究,在阿姆哈拉语对英语,阿拉伯语对英语,西班牙语对英语数据上分别进行微调.
我们比较了第3款在超参数设置、翻译质量和一般能力方面的减缓方法(第4款)。
第2阶段是主要的实验.
我们在Llama 3.1 8B上应用选定的配置,并在阿拉伯语-英语或西班牙语-英语的双向数据上进行微调。
除了翻译质量和一般能力外,我们评价MT-IF格式、语法性别和长度控制(第4.3节)。

blocks.en:
On the 1B model, standard fine-tuning decreases the average score on the general benchmarks by 6.3 to 8.1 points across the three language pairs.
Elastic Weight Consolidation (EWC) limits this decrease to 2.5 or less, and its configurations trace the Pareto frontier of learning against forgetting.
The Stage 2 results show a different pattern for MT-IF. On the 8B model, EWC retains general capabilities, but its scores for formality and grammatical gender control remain close to those of standard fine-tuning (illustrated in Figure 1 ). Among the methods evaluated in Stage 2, only data mixing with examples of the corresponding control task preserves these controls. Ablations show no consistent transfer between grammatical gender and formality control.
Our contributions are: 1. A comparison of forgetting mitigation methods anchored to auxiliary data, to model outputs, and to the base model parameters, for MT fine-tuning of instruction-tuned LLMs, across three language pairs and two model sizes. 2. Evidence from formality, grammatical gender, and length control that retention on general benchmarks can coexist with losses in MT-IF, so general benchmark scores alone can miss capabilities affected by MT fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
在1B模式上,标准微调将一般基准上的平均分数减少6.3分到8.1分,跨越三种语言对.
弹性重量综合(EWC)将这一减少限制在2.5或更少,其配置可以追溯到帕雷托边际的学习避免遗忘.
第二阶段的结果表明,MT-IF模式不同。 在8B模式中,EWC保留了一般能力,但其形式性和语法性别控制的分数仍然接近标准微调的分数(如图1所示)。 在第二阶段所评价的方法中,只有与相应控制任务实例混合的数据才保留这些控制。 通缩显示语法性别与形式控制之间没有一致的转移.
我们的贡献是: 1. 对基于辅助数据、模型输出和基准模型参数的忘却缓解方法进行比较,以对指令调制的LLMs进行MT微调,跨越三种语言对称和两种模型大小。 2. 形式性,语法性别,以及长度控制等证据证明,保留一般基准可以与MT-IF的损失共存,因此仅一般基准分数就可以错过MT微调影响的能力.

blocks.en: A comparison of forgetting mitigation methods anchored to auxiliary data, to model outputs, and to the base model parameters, for MT fine-tuning of instruction-tuned LLMs, across three language pairs and two model sizes.
blocks.zh: 对基于辅助数据、模型输出和基准模型参数的忘却缓解方法进行比较,以便对指导调制的LLMs进行MT微调,分为三个语言对和两个模型大小。

blocks.en: Evidence from formality, grammatical gender, and length control that retention on general benchmarks can coexist with losses in MT-IF, so general benchmark scores alone can miss capabilities affected by MT fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 形式性,语法性别,以及长度控制等证据证明在一般基准上保留可以与MT-IF中的损失并存,因此仅一般基准分数就可以错过受到MT微调影响的能力.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Our study draws on two lines of research, the mitigation of catastrophic forgetting during LLM fine-tuning and the control of translation attributes such as formality, grammatical gender, and length.
blocks.zh: 我们的研究借鉴了两条研究线,一是减轻LLM微调过程中的灾难性遗忘,二是控制形式性,语法性别,长度等翻译属性.

blocks.en:
Stap et al. (2024) observe that fine-tuning pre-trained LLMs on parallel data improves translation quality but degrades formality steering, few-shot translation, and document-level translation.
They fine-tune pretrained-only base models, elicit the affected abilities with few-shot prompting, and evaluate a single mitigation method, mixing in monolingual data.
We instead start from instruction-tuned models, compare eleven methods, and measure zero-shot instruction following, the interface through which these controls are used in practice. Liu and Niehues (2025) study the loss of translation ability for languages unseen during fine-tuning and find that the relative scale of model and data is a primary determinant, while parameter-efficient fine-tuning offers no clear advantage over full fine-tuning.
blocks.zh:
Stap等人(2024年)指出,对平行数据进行事先培训的LLMS进行微调可提高翻译质量,但可降低格式引导、少拍翻译和文件一级翻译。
它们精细地调整了事先经过训练的、只有基础模型,以很少的镜头提示来吸引受影响的能力,并评价一种单一的缓解方法,混合在单一语言的数据中。
相反,我们从指导调整模型开始,比较11种方法,然后衡量零射指令,这些控制在实践中使用的界面。 刘和涅胡斯(2025年)研究微调时所未见的语言翻译能力的丧失,发现模型和数据的相对规模是主要的决定因素,而参数效率微调则比完全微调没有明显的优势.

blocks.en:
We draw the methods we compare from this literature ( Kirkpatrick et al., 2017 ; Rolnick et al., 2019 ; Hu et al., 2022 ; Tian et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Zheng et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Diao et al., 2026 ) and describe each of them in Section 3 .
The evidence behind them was collected outside MT.
Earlier approaches were validated on supervised and reinforcement learning benchmarks ( Kirkpatrick et al., 2017 ; Rolnick et al., 2019 ) and on vision and language classification tasks ( Tian et al., 2024 ) , while recent work fine-tunes on mathematical reasoning, code, medical, or agentic data and measures retention with general benchmarks ( Biderman et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Diao et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
我们从这些文献(Kirkpatrick等人,2017年;Rolnick等人,2019年;Hu等人,2022年;Tian等人,2017年)中提取了我们比较的方法. 2024; Yang et al., 2026; Zheng et al., 2025; Wu et al., 2025; Diao et al., 2026),并在第三节中分别描述.
背后的证据是在MT之外收集的.
早期的方法被验证为有监督和强化的学习基准(Kirkpatrick等人,2017年;Rolnick等人,2019年)和视觉和语言分类任务(Tian等人,2024年),而近期的工作则在数学推理,代码,医学或代理数据和措施保留方面进行了微调,并附有一般基准(Biderman等人,2024年;Wu等人,2025年;Diao等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Our experiments focus on mitigation during off-policy SFT, where the training responses are fixed rather than sampled from the current model. Recent comparisons, including one on MT, find that on-policy reinforcement learning often retains prior capabilities better than SFT ( Shenfeld et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026 ; Su et al., 2026 ) , although Luo et al. (2026) report substantial forgetting during continual reinforcement learning on multimodal reasoning tasks. These studies do not evaluate retention of translation-specific instruction following.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验侧重于在政策外的SFT期间的缓解,培训对策是固定的,而不是从目前的模型中取样。 最近进行的比较,包括关于MT的比较,发现政策强化学习往往比SFT更好地保留先前的能力(Shenfeld等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年;Su等人,2026年),尽管Luo等人(2026年)报告说,在不断强化学习多模式推理任务的过程中,被大量遗忘。 这些研究不评估是否保留了随后的翻译教学。

blocks.en:
Conventional NMT supports controlled translation of attributes such as politeness, length, grammatical gender, and formality through labeled data and dedicated mechanisms, including source- and word-level tags, modified positional encodings, and constrained rescoring or reranking ( Sennrich et al., 2016 ; Lakew et al., 2019 ; Saunders et al., 2020 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) . Raunak et al. (2024) fine-tune a single NMT model on parallel and task-specific instruction data, where each instruction is a short task description, such as “informal” , prepended to the source inside dedicated demarcation tokens.
Instruction-tuned LLMs instead accept such requests as free-form natural language prompts.
We study whether fine-tuning on parallel data degrades this ability and whether forgetting-mitigation methods preserve it.
blocks.zh:
常规NMT支持通过标注数据和专用机制,包括源和词级标记,修改位置编码,以及限制重评或重新排序等属性的可控翻译,如礼貌,长度,语法性别,形式等(Sennrich等人,2016年;Lakew等人,2019年;Saunders等人,2020年;Wu等人,2023年). 劳纳克等人. (2024)在平行和任务特定指令数据上微调单一的NMT模型,其中每个指令都是一个简短的任务描述,如"非正式的",准备在专用的划界标志内提供给源.
指令调制LLMs则接受这种请求,如自由形式的自然语言提示.
我们研究对平行数据的微调是否降低这种能力,忘却方法是否保留这种能力。

blocks.en:
Attribute-specific MT benchmarks evaluate phenomena relevant to controlled translation.
WinoMT ( Stanovsky et al., 2019 ) and MuST-SHE ( Bentivogli et al., 2020 ) target gender translation accuracy,
CoCoA-MT ( Nadejde et al., 2022 ) provides contrastive formal and informal references,
MT-GenEval ( Currey et al., 2022 ) adds gender-balanced counterfactual and contextual examples, and
mGeNTE ( Savoldi et al., 2025 ) instead evaluates gender-neutral translation.
We adapt CoCoA-MT and MT-GenEval, together with FLORES, into targeted evaluations of formality, grammatical gender, and length control, as described in Section 4.3 .
Broader recent benchmarks assess translation and instruction adherence jointly.
IF-MT tests two to four verifiable instructions for English-to-Chinese and English-to-Spanish translation and scores translation quality and adherence separately ( Rei et al., 2026 ) .
Concurrent work introduces IFMTBench, which evaluates single and composed instructions across seven languages and several lexical, contextual, structural, and stylistic constraints ( Sun et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
特定属性的MT基准评价与受控翻译相关的现象.
WinoMT(Stanovsky等人,2019年)和MuST-SHE(Bentivogli等人,2020年)的目标是性别翻译准确性,
CoCoA-MT(Nadejde等人,2022年)提供了对比的正式和非正式参考文献,
MT-GenEval(Currey等人,2022年)增加了性别均衡的反事实和背景实例,以及
mGENTE(Savoldi等人,2025年)则评价性别中立翻译.
如第4.3节所述,我们将CoCoA-MT和MT-GenEval以及FLORES调整为对形式、语法性别和长度控制进行有针对性的评价。
最近更广泛的基准共同评估翻译和遵守指令的情况。
IF-MT对英文对中文和英文对西班牙文的翻译进行2至4个可核查的指令测试,并分别对翻译质量和坚持程度进行评分(Rei等人,2026年).
同时期工作引入了IFMT Bench,它评价了七种语言的单语和由语法、语境、结构和语义制约组成的指令(Sun等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: 3 Mitigation Methods
blocks.zh: 3 缓解方法

blocks.en:
The compared methods differ in the reference signal they use to mitigate forgetting during fine-tuning.
We call this signal the anchor and group the methods by it: auxiliary data that represents the capabilities to be kept ( Section 3.1 ), the output distribution of a model on the fine-tuning data ( Section 3.2 ), and the parameters of the base model ( Section 3.3 ).
The anchor bounds what a method can preserve, which we return to in Section 7 .
Several of the methods are orthogonal and could be combined, but we evaluate each in isolation to compare their individual contributions.
blocks.zh:
比较方法在用于微调时减轻遗忘的参考信号上有所不同.
我们称这个信号为锚和组它的方法:代表应保存能力的辅助数据(第3.1节),微调数据模型的输出分布(第3.2节),基准模型参数(第3.3节).
我们回到第7节。
几种方法是正统的,可以合并,但我们单独评估每一种方法,以比较它们各自的贡献。

blocks.en: 3.1 Anchoring to Auxiliary Data
blocks.zh: 3.1 辅助数据

blocks.en: Rolnick et al. (2019) replays a fraction of general-domain instruction data into the fine-tuning data instead of training on MT alone.
blocks.zh: Rolnick等人(2019年)将一小部分通用域指令数据重放到微调数据中,而不是只进行MT培训.

blocks.en: Yang et al. (2026) combines the parameters of two independently trained models. We merge a model fine-tuned on MT with a model trained on general-domain data by linear interpolation, that is, weight averaging.
blocks.zh: 杨等人(2026年)结合了两个独立训练的模型的参数. 我们通过线性插值,即平均重量,将MT上的模型和一般域数据培训模型合并。

blocks.en: Kirkpatrick et al. (2017) adds a quadratic penalty on the distance from the base parameters, scaled by a hyperparameter λ \lambda and weighted per parameter by the diagonal of the empirical Fisher information estimated on the auxiliary data. Its penalty is in parameter space, but the importance estimate that shapes it comes from the auxiliary data, which is why we group it here. Liu and Chang (2026) propose EWC-DR , which reverses the logits when computing Fisher information and thereby reduces the redundant protection of parameters that the standard EWC applies.
blocks.zh: Kirkpatrick等人(2017年)在离基准参数的距离上增加了一个四极判罚,用一个超参数XX\lambda来缩放,用辅助数据上估计的经验费舍尔信息对角来加权每个参数. 它的判罚是在参数空间中,但是其形状的重要性估计来自辅助数据,这就是为什么我们把它分组在这里. 刘和昌(2026年)提出EWC-DR(EWC-DR),在计算费舍尔信息时反转对数,从而减少标准EWC适用的参数的冗余保护.

blocks.en: All methods in this group draw their anchor from the same subset of the Tülu 3 SFT mixture ( Section A.1 ), so what they retain is bounded by the capabilities that this data covers.
blocks.zh: 该组中的所有方法都从Tülu 3 SFT混合物的同一子集(A.1节)中引出它们的锚,因此它们所保留的东西受本数据涵盖的能力的制约.

blocks.en: 3.2 Anchoring to Model Outputs
blocks.zh: 3.2 确定产出模式

blocks.en: We add the exact KL divergence between the output distributions of the model being trained and a frozen copy of the base model as a penalty scaled by λ \lambda on the SFT loss Shenfeld et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 我们添加了正在训练的模型输出分布与底模型冻结副本之间的精确KL差异,作为对SFT损失Shenfeld等人(2026年)的处罚。

blocks.en:
removes tokens from the loss instead of penalizing divergence. Wu et al. (2025) observe that fine-tuning on LLM-generated responses forgets less than fine-tuning on ground-truth data, tracing this to the lower token-level perplexity of generated text, and therefore mask ground-truth tokens whose perplexity exceeds a fixed threshold.
We instead set the threshold dynamically and mask the X % X\% of tokens with the highest perplexity under a frozen copy of the base model.
blocks.zh:
消除损失中的标志,而不是惩罚分歧。 Wu等人(2025年)指出,对LLM生成的响应进行微调会忘记对地面真实数据的微调,将其追踪到生成文本的低符号级的迷惑,从而掩盖了其迷惑度超过固定阈值的地面真实信使.
相反,我们以动态方式设定了门槛值,并用冻结的底模拷贝中最复杂的方式掩盖了X%的代币。

blocks.en: Diao et al. (2026) identify confident conflicts, tokens with low probability and low entropy, as a cause of forgetting, because fitting them overwrites a confident prior. Masking the tokens in the bottom X % X\% of both quantities mitigates forgetting, but discards useful training signal.
blocks.zh: 钓鱼岛等. (2026年)将自信冲突,概率低和 en度低的标志确定为遗忘的原因,因为安装它们会覆盖一个自信的前身. 在两个数量的 X% 的底部装上标记可以减轻遗忘,但丢弃有用的训练信号。

blocks.en: addresses this by weighting the loss of each token by its entropy normalized over the top- K K distribution, instead of discarding the token Diao et al. (2026) .
blocks.zh: 解决这个问题的方法是,将每个信物的损耗加权,使其在KK上方的分布上正常化,而不是丢弃信物Diao等人(2026年)。

blocks.en: CC and EAFT take the output from the model being trained rather than from a frozen copy. All methods in this group are computed on the MT fine-tuning data, so they bound how far the model moves on translation inputs and place no constraint on its behavior on other prompts.
blocks.zh: CC和EAFT取自正在训练的模型而不是冷冻的拷贝的输出. 这个组中的所有方法都是在MT微调数据上计算出来的,因此它们将模型在翻译输入上移动了多远,并且不限制它的行为在其他提示上.

blocks.en: 3.3 Anchoring to the Base Model Parameters
blocks.zh: 3.3 确定基准模型参数

blocks.en: keeps the bottom N N layers at their base values and trains the remaining ones. Zheng et al. (2025) propose this on the grounds that task alignment is concentrated in the bottom layers and is disrupted during the first optimization steps.
blocks.zh: 将底部的N N 层保持在它们的底值上,并训练其余的. 郑等人(2025年)提出此建议,理由是任务对齐集中在底层,并在最初的优化步骤中中断.

blocks.en: Tian et al. (2024) modifies the Adam optimizer to apply weight decay toward the pre-trained weights selectively. A gradient condition determines for each parameter tensor whether the update is heading toward a higher-loss region, and only those tensors receive the penalty, weighted by λ \lambda , while the remaining ones are updated without intervention.
blocks.zh: 天等译. (2024)修改了亚当优化器,以选择性地将重量衰减应用到预先训练的重量上. 一个梯度条件决定了每个参数的变速器是否正在走向一个损失较高的区域,只有那些变速器会得到罚分,加权为 \\\ lambda , 而其余的变速器则不加干预地更新。

blocks.en: Hu et al. (2022) restricts fine-tuning updates to a low-rank subspace, which is believed to keep the model close to its base weights and thus limit forgetting ( Sun et al., 2023 ) . However, Biderman et al. (2024) show this holds only insofar as LoRA also learns less, with high-rank LoRA forgetting nearly as much as full fine-tuning in some settings.
blocks.zh: 胡等编著. (2022年)将微调更新限制在低级亚空间,据信这可以使模型保持接近其基重,从而限制遗忘(Sun等人,2023年). 然而,Biderman等人(2024年)表明,这种情况只表现在LORA也学习较少,而一些情况下,高排名的LORA忘记了几乎同样全面的微调。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Stage 1: Translation quality (COMET) versus general capabilities (General Avg) for all evaluated configurations per training language on the Llama 3.2 1B Instruct model. Lines connect hyperparameter settings within each method; dashed lines mark the SFT baseline.
blocks.zh: 图2:阶段1:Llama 3.2 1B 教程模型上每个培训语言的所有评价配置的翻译质量(COMET)与一般能力(General Avg)对比. 线在每种方法内连接超参数设置;虚线标注SFT基线.

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation of Model Capabilities
blocks.zh: 4. 模型能力评价

blocks.en: We evaluate translation quality with COMET and BLEU, retention on general benchmarks, and three MT-specific controls: formality, grammatical gender, and length. These controlled-translation evaluations are targeted diagnostics of forgetting rather than a general benchmark of MT instruction following.
blocks.zh: 我们用COMET和BLEU评价翻译质量,保留一般基准,以及三个MT特定控制:形式、语法性别和长度。 这些受控翻译评价是针对遗忘的诊断,而不是随后的MT教学的一般基准。

blocks.en: 4.1 Translation Quality
blocks.zh: 4.1 翻译质量

blocks.en: We report reference-based COMET with Unbabel/wmt22-comet-da ( Rei et al., 2022 ) and corpus BLEU with sacreBLEU ( Post, 2018 ) , using the default 13a tokenizer for our language pairs. Before scoring, hypotheses and references are punctuation- and whitespace-normalized.
blocks.zh: 我们用Unbabel/wmt22-comet-da(Rei等人,2022年)和用SacreBleU(Post,2018年)来报告基于参考的COMET,我们的语言对称使用默认的13a符号。 评分前,假设和引用都是点球-和白空-常态化.

blocks.en: 4.2 General Capabilities
blocks.zh: 4.2 一般能力

blocks.en:
Our general-capability benchmarks are a subset of the Tülu 3 evaluation suite ( Lambert et al., 2025 ) , which covers knowledge recall, reasoning, math, coding, and instruction following.
From its development split, we take GSM8K ( Cobbe et al., 2021 ) , DROP ( Dua et al., 2019 ) , TruthfulQA ( Lin et al., 2022 ) , Codex HumanEval ( Chen et al., 2021 ) , Codex HumanEval+ ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , and IFEval ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) , the last of which assesses general instruction following.
From its unseen split, we take AGIEval English ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) and GPQA ( Rein et al., 2024 ) , both zero-shot with chain-of-thought prompting.
We run all of them with the task formulations and prompts of the Tülu 3 evaluation regime, using the OLMES evaluation standard ( Gu et al., 2025 ) .
We report the mean of the eight task scores as the general average (General Avg).
blocks.zh:
我们的一般能力基准是Tülu 3评价套件(Lambert等人,2025年)的一个子集,涵盖知识召回、推理、数学、编码和随后的教学。
从其发展分裂中,我们取GSM8K(Cobbe等人,2021年),DROP(Dua等人,2019年),TrealFulQA(Lin等人,2022年),Codex HumanEval(Chen等人,2021年),Codex HumanEval+(Liu等人,2023年),IFEval(周等人,2023年),其中最后一个评估了以下的一般性指示.
我们用AGIEval英语(Zhong等人,2024年)和GPQA(Rein等人,2024年),
我们利用 " Tülu 3 " 评价制度的任务制定和提示,使用 " OLMES " 评价标准(Gu等人,2025年)。
我们报告八项任务的平均值为共同平均数(Avg将军)。

blocks.en: 4.3 Machine Translation-Specific IF
blocks.zh: 4.3 机器翻译专用IF

blocks.en: To evaluate MT-IF capabilities, we assess models on the following three tasks closely related to MT:
blocks.zh: 为了评估MT-IF能力,我们评估与MT密切相关的下列三项任务的模式:

blocks.en: To assess formality, we prompt the model to produce a formal or informal translation on the CoCoA-MT dataset ( Nadejde et al., 2022 ) for en → \rightarrow de and en → \rightarrow es , and score with its metric: a hypothesis is classified as formal if it contains at least one of the annotated formal marked phrases from the reference pair and no informal ones (symmetrically for informal), and is left unmatched otherwise. The reported accuracy is the proportion of matched hypotheses whose classified formality matches the requested tone.
blocks.zh: 为了评估形式性,我们促使该模型在CoCoA-MT数据集(Nadejde等人,2022年)上提供正式或非正式译文,用于 en \rightarrow de 和 en \rightarrow es ),并以其衡量标准得分:如果一个假说至少包含参考对中附加说明的正式标记短语之一,而不是非正式的(对称地用于非正式),则该假说被归类为形式性,否则就无与伦比。 报告的准确性是分类形式符合要求的语气的匹配假设的比例。

blocks.en:
To assess control over grammatical gender, we use the MT-GenEval benchmark ( Currey et al., 2022 ) , which provides counterfactual sentence pairs that differ in the gender forms used for a person mentioned in the text.
We instruct the model to produce a translation with the opposite gender forms of the source sentence (i.e., masculine → \rightarrow feminine, feminine → \rightarrow masculine).
The instruction asks the model to override the forms suggested by the source, which separates instruction following from the model’s default choice of gender forms.
We follow the same evaluation procedure from the benchmark by checking for the absence of unique opposite-gender words in the hypothesis.
blocks.zh:
为了评估对语法性别的控制,我们采用了MT-GenEval基准(Currey等人,2022年),该基准提供了反事实句子对文本中提及的人的性别形式不同.
我们指示该模式制作一个译文,其中包含源句的相反性别形式(即男性 \ 右翼女性 \ 右翼男性)。
该指示要求该模型推翻来源建议的表格,该表格将遵循该模型默认选择的性别表格区分开来。
我们从基准中遵循同样的评估程序,检查假设中是否存在独特的异性别词。

blocks.en:
We adapt the FLORES-101 and FLORES-200 benchmarks ( Goyal et al., 2022 ; Costa-jussà et al., 2024 ) for the bidirectional translation between English and the training language. In particular, we add additional instructions on producing shorter or longer translations than the character count of the source.
As the produced sequence length is heavily influenced by fine-tuning, we compare whether the instruction affected the output by comparing the translation with longer/shorter instructions to the baseline translation (instead of measuring pure accuracy on IF). This shows the effect of the additional instruction on length control and whether the model actually considered the instruction. We additionally report the target/source (tgt/src) ratios to understand length trends better.
blocks.zh:
FLORES-101和FLORES-200基准(Goyal等人,2022年;Costa-jussà等人,2024年)适用于英语和培训语言之间的双向翻译。 特别是,我们增加了关于制作短或长于来源字符计数的翻译的额外指令.
由于制作的序列长度受到微调的很大影响,我们通过将翻译与较长/较短的指令与基线翻译(而不是测量IF上的纯精度)相比较,来比较指令是否影响了输出. 这表明附加指令对长度控制的影响,以及模型是否实际考虑该指令. 我们还报告目标/源(tgt/src)比率,以更好地了解长度趋势。

blocks.en: Table 1: Stage 1: Best-performing configuration per method for Amharic, selected by the highest sum of Amharic-language COMET and general average score. The cell shading encodes the absolute differences from the base instruct model, normalized relative to the largest observed change within each metric group (across languages).
blocks.zh: 表1:阶段 1:阿姆哈拉语每种方法的最佳配置,由阿姆哈拉语COMET最高和一般平均分总和选择. 单元格阴影编码了与基准指示模型的绝对差异,相对于每个计量组(跨语言)中观察到的最大变化而言,这些差异是正常化的。

blocks.en: 5 Stage 1: Transfer of Mitigation Techniques to Machine Translation Fine-tuning
blocks.zh: 5 第一阶段:向机器翻译转让缓解技术 微调

blocks.en: 5.1 Data
blocks.zh: 5.1 数据

blocks.en: We fine-tune models on unidirectional translation data for three language pairs: Amharic → \rightarrow English, Arabic → \rightarrow English, and Spanish → \rightarrow English, each containing 1,000,068 samples. For Data Mixing, Model Merging, and for computing the Fisher matrix in EWC, we use subsets of the Tülu 3 SFT mixture ( Lambert et al., 2025 ) of varying sizes, from which we remove synthetic instruction-following data to prevent overlap with the IFEval benchmark used for evaluation (see Section A.1 for more details on the distribution of our training data).
blocks.zh: 我们对三种语言的单向翻译数据模型进行微调: 阿姆哈拉语 \ 右手的英语,阿拉伯语 \ 右手的英语,西班牙语 \ 右手的英语,每个样本包含1000,068个样本. 在数据混合、模型合并和计算EWC中的Fisher矩阵时,我们使用不同尺寸的Tülu 3 SFT混合物(Lambert等人,2025年)的子集,从中去除与用于评价的IFEval基准重叠的合成指令跟踪数据(关于我们培训数据的分布的更多详情,见A.1节)。

blocks.en: 5.2 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 5.2 实验设置

blocks.en: In the first stage of our experiments, we fine-tune the Llama 3.2 1B Instruct model with the mitigation methods previously introduced, comparing various hyperparameter settings. We compare the fine-tuned models against two baselines: the unmodified instruct model and standard SFT.
blocks.zh: 在我们的实验的第一阶段,我们微调了Llama 3.2 1B指令模型与之前采用的缓解方法,比较了各种超参数设置. 我们把微调模型与两个基线进行比较:未经修改的指令模型和标准SFT.

blocks.en: We report BLEU and COMET scores for translation on the training language pair and on German-to-English, included as an out-of-distribution language pair ( Section 4.1 ). We use FLORES-101 ( Goyal et al., 2022 ) for Amharic and Spanish, and FLORES-200 ( Costa-jussà et al., 2024 ) for Arabic and German. We additionally evaluate the forgetting of general capabilities, as described in Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 我们报告BLEU和COMET的分数,供在培训语言对等和德语对英语中进行翻译,这些分数作为分配外语言对等(第4.1节)。 FLORES-101(Goyal等人,2022年)用于阿姆哈拉语和西班牙语,FLORES-200(Costa-jussà等人,2024年)用于阿拉伯语和德语。 我们进一步评价第4节所述的忘记一般能力的情况。

blocks.en: 5.3 Results
blocks.zh: 5.3 结果

blocks.en: We present the MT scores and the general average of the best-performing configurations for Amharic in Table 1 (Arabic and Spanish in Table 10 ). These configurations are chosen based on the highest sum of COMET and general average scores. Additionally, we visualize the results of all 40 Amharic, 27 Spanish, and 28 Arabic configuration training runs in Figure 2 showing the trade-off between general capabilities and MT performance.
blocks.zh: 我们在表1(表10中的阿拉伯文和西班牙文)中列出了阿姆哈拉语的MT分数和表现最佳组合的总平均值。 这些配置是根据COMET和普通平均分的最高总和来选择的. 此外,我们将所有40个阿姆哈拉语、27个西班牙语和28个阿拉伯语配置培训的结果如图2所示,显示一般能力和MT性能之间的权衡。

blocks.en: Overall, we observe the SFT baselines of all three languages to maintain similar forgetting rates (Amharic: 6.3, Arabic: 8.1, Spanish: 7.0) despite the different improvements in learning the MT task (Amharic: 25.9, Arabic: 8.5, Spanish: 4.9). Even though German was not included as a language pair in training, German MT scores slightly improve after fine-tuning, indicating no forgetting on a similar translation task.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,我们观察到所有三种语言的SFT基线,以保持类似的遗忘率(阿姆哈拉语:6.3,阿拉伯语:8.1,西班牙语:7.0),尽管在学习MT任务方面有不同的改进(阿姆哈拉语:25.9,阿拉伯语:8.5,西班牙语:4.9)。 尽管德语没有作为一对语言被纳入培训,但德语MT的成绩在微调后略有改善,表明不会忘记类似的翻译任务.

blocks.en: Across all three training languages, the majority of evaluated configurations are clustered around the SFT baseline in Figure 2 (dashed lines). Only a small number of methods consistently separate from this cluster by forgetting less on general capabilities (General Avg) at comparable COMET scores. In particular, the EWC family (EWC, EWC-DR) and Merge appear in the upper-right region in all three plots, while Data Mixing and SPD show mediocre mitigation of forgetting.
blocks.zh: 在所有三种培训语言中,大多数评估的配置都围绕SFT基线在图2(线条)中进行组合。 只有少数方法与这一组一致地分开,在可比的彗星分数中较少忘记一般能力(General Avg). 特别是,EWC家族(EWC,EWC-DR)和合并出现在所有三块地块的上右翼区域,而Data Mixing和SPD则表现出平庸的缓解遗忘.

blocks.en: The only two techniques showing clear differences between languages are Selective Token Masking (STM) and LoRA, each diverging in opposite directions when comparing Amharic with Spanish and Arabic. LoRA performs comparatively better on Amharic by trading a smaller gain on MT performance (COMET: +21.6 vs. +25.9 in standard SFT) for a slightly smaller drop in the general average ( − 5.3 -5.3 ), whereas STM performs better on Arabic and Spanish than for Amharic where it significantly hindered learning (COMET: 65.9).
blocks.zh: 语言之间明显不同的仅有两种技术是Selective Token Masking(TM)和LORA,在将阿姆哈拉语与西班牙语和阿拉伯语进行比较时,每种技术都存在相反方向的差异。 LoRA在阿姆哈拉语方面表现相对较好,通过将MT性能收益(COMET:+21.6 vs.+25.9标准SFT)交易给一般平均水平略小的下降(−5.3-5.3),而STM在阿拉伯语和西班牙语方面的表现则优于阿姆哈拉语,因为后者严重阻碍了学习(COMET:65.9)。

blocks.en:
Individual EWC configurations trade translation quality against general capabilities, spreading along the upper-right boundary of Figure 2 between standard SFT and the base model rather than occupying a single point.
Any method with a continuous coefficient produces such a curve between the two baselines, and the sweeps of Merge, Data Mixing, KL, and STM reach the region where COMET falls below standard SFT.
Their curves lie below the EWC curve: for almost every configuration of another method, some EWC setting reaches both a higher COMET and a higher general average, in all three languages.
The remaining frontier points are configurations of standard SFT and a few other methods that gain up to a few tenths of COMET over the best EWC setting at the cost of several points on the general average.
blocks.zh:
单个的EWC配置以一般能力进行交易翻译质量,沿着图2的右上方边界在标准SFT和基模型之间展开,而不是占据一个点.
任何具有连续系数的方法都会在两个基线之间产生这样的曲线,对合并,数据混合,KL和STM的扫射会到达彗星低于标准SFT的区域.
他们的曲线位于EWC曲线下方:对于另一种方法的几乎所有配置,一些EWC设置都达到了所有三种语言的较高彗星和较高的一般平均值.
其余的前沿点是标准SFT的配置和几种其他方法,它们比最佳的EWC设定要多出几分之十的COMET,而共同平均值为几分。

blocks.en:
The language-dependent differences of LoRA and STM noted above suggest that the extent of learning required, rather than the language itself, drives the differences in forgetting mitigation trends.
As we are not aware of resources to evaluate MT-IF on Amharic, we reduce the Stage 2 experiments to Spanish and Arabic.
Additionally, as EWC performed better than EWC-DR, we drop the latter.
blocks.zh:
上文提到的LORA和STM在语言上的差异表明,所需要的学习程度,而不是语言本身,促使人们忘记缓解趋势。
由于我们不知道对阿姆哈拉语的MT-IF进行评估的资源,我们把第二阶段的试验减少到西班牙语和阿拉伯语。
此外,由于EWC的表现优于EWC-DR,我们放弃后者。

blocks.en: 6 Stage 2: Comparison to Machine Translation Instruction Following Tasks
blocks.zh: 6 阶段2: 跟机器翻译指令的比较

blocks.en: 6.1 Data
blocks.zh: 6.1 数据

blocks.en:
We fine-tune models with bidirectional, open data from two languages to improve reproducibility: Spanish ↔ \leftrightarrow English and Arabic ↔ \leftrightarrow English.
Each dataset has a total size of 1,000,000 samples, consisting of 500,000 pairs per direction (see Section A.1 for detailed information on the training data distribution).
blocks.zh:
我们用两种语言的双向开放数据微调模型,
每个数据集的总规模为1,000,000个样本,每个方向有50万对(关于培训数据分配的详细资料,见A.1节)。

blocks.en:
Alongside the Tülu 3 subsets used in Stage 1, we mix in data closely related to our MT-IF tasks: the training split of CoCoA-MT (Spanish, N=400; German N=400) ( Nadejde et al., 2022 ) and the dev split of MT-GenEval (Arabic, Spanish, and German evenly distributed; N=800) ( Currey et al., 2022 ) .
We primarily use the same prompts as during evaluation, but additionally run variants with a different prompt to assess whether the observed effects generalize to unseen prompts (see Sections A.5 and A.6 for prompts used).
blocks.zh:
除了第一阶段使用的Tülu 3子集,我们混合了与我们的MT-IF任务密切相关的数据:CoCoA-MT(西班牙语,N=400;德语N=400)(Nadejde等人,2022年)的训练分裂和MT-GenEval(阿拉伯语、西班牙语和德语均匀分布;N=800)的dev分裂. (Currey等人,2022年).
我们主要使用与评价期间相同的提示,但另外使用不同提示的变体来评估所观察到的效果是否普遍到看不见的提示(所用提示见A.5和A.6节)。

blocks.en: 6.2 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 6.2 实验设置

blocks.en:
We move to Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, whose base performance on the MT-IF tasks is high enough to measure their forgetting, and to open, bidirectional training data.
Model size, translation directions, and data source therefore change together between the two stages.
We take the best performing configurations per method identified in the previous stage as a starting point and only slightly re-tune them for the larger model trained on open, bidirectional data, in contrast to re-screening all possible configurations.
blocks.zh:
我们转到Llama 3.1 8B Instructionct, 其MT-IF任务的基础性能足够高,可以测量他们的遗忘,并打开双向训练数据.
因此,模型大小、翻译方向和数据来源在两个阶段之间共同变化。
我们把前一阶段确定的每一方法的最佳性能配置作为起点,只略微重新调整它们,用于在开放的双向数据上训练的更大模型,与重新筛选所有可能的配置形成对比.

blocks.en:
We reuse the Stage 1 evaluation setup (COMET, BLEU, and the general average; Section 5.2 ), but evaluate translation in both directions.
Beyond these scores, we evaluate our models on the three MT-IF control tasks, as defined in Section 4.3 : Formality Control (Spanish, German; only for Spanish training runs), Grammatical Gender Control (Training Language, German), and Length Control (Training Language).
We evaluate MT-IF only in Stage 2, as CoCoA-MT and MT-GenEval only cover translations from English to other languages and the MT-IF capabilities of the 1B model are too low to measure forgetting.
We summarize the controls as the MT-IF average (MT-IF Avg): the mean of the training-language scores of the three tasks, where formality and grammatical gender contribute their average accuracy and length control contributes the mean compliance rate under the shorter and longer instructions.
For Arabic, the average covers only grammatical gender and length control, as CoCoA-MT provides no Arabic formality data.
blocks.zh:
我们重新使用第一阶段评价设置(COMET、BLEU和一般平均数;第5.2节),但评价双向翻译。
除了这些分数之外,我们还将评估第4.3节所界定的三个MT-IF控制任务的模型: 形式控制(西班牙语、德语;仅用于西班牙语培训)、语法性别控制(德语培训)和长度控制(德语培训)。
我们只在第二阶段对MT-IF进行评价,因为CoCoA-MT和MT-GenEval只涵盖从英文译成其他语文,1B模型的MT-IF能力太低,无法衡量是否忘记。
我们把控制归纳为MT-IF平均值(MT-IF Avg):三个任务中培训语言分数的平均值,其中形式和语法性别为平均准确性作出贡献,长度控制为较短和更长指令下的平均遵守率作出贡献。
对于阿拉伯语,平均只涵盖语法性别和长度控制,因为CoCoA-MT没有提供阿拉伯语形式数据.

blocks.en: 6.3 Results
blocks.zh: 6.3 结果

blocks.en: 6.3.1 Forgetting of General Capabilities
blocks.zh: 6.3.1 忘记一般能力

blocks.en:
We present the MT scores and the general average of our bidirectional training runs on Spanish in Table 2 and on Arabic in Table 20 (Appendix).
Standard SFT forgets more on general capabilities at 8B than at 1B in Stage 1, with the general average (base 66.8) dropping 11.0 points for Spanish and 8.3 points for Arabic, despite much smaller MT learning gains (COMET +1.0 vs. +4.9 at 1B for Spanish).
Since model size, translation directions, and data source change together between the stages, we cannot attribute this difference to one of them.
The ordering of the methods is largely stable across stages: EWC retains the most in both, Merge, SPD, and Data Mixing retain moderately, and the methods anchored to model outputs stay within two points of standard SFT.
Changes in ordering occur where Stage 1 differences were already small. CC and Freeze, within 1.3 points of standard SFT at 1B, now fall 0.8 to 1.6 points below it.
The exception is STM, which retained 4.1 to 4.5 points more than standard SFT for Spanish and Arabic in Stage 1 at the cost of COMET, and at 8B loses 2.5 to 2.8 points more than standard SFT (53.0 for Spanish, 56.0 for Arabic) while still learning less.
blocks.zh:
我们在表2和表20(附录)中分别以西班牙文和阿拉伯文列出MT分数和我们双向培训的总平均数。
标准SFT在8B时比第一阶段1B时忘记了一般能力,西班牙语的平均平均数(66.8基准)下降了11.0分,阿拉伯语下降了8.3分,尽管MT学习的成绩要小得多(COMET+1.0 vs.+4.9 at 1B in Spanish)。
由于模型大小,翻译方向,和数据源在各阶段之间一起变化,我们不能将这种差异归因于其中之一.
方法的顺序在各阶段基本稳定:EWC保留最多的两个阶段,合并、SPD和Data Mixing均保持中度,用于模型输出的方法保持在标准SFT的两个点之内。
在第一阶段的差别已经很小的情况下,顺序会发生变化。 CC和冻结,在标准SFT1B的1.3点范围内,现在降到低于0.8到1.6点.
例外是STM,在第一阶段,以CAWT为代价,为西班牙语和阿拉伯语保留了比标准SFT多4.1至4.5分,在8B时,比标准SFT(西班牙语53.0分,阿拉伯语56.0分)损失2.5至2.8分,而学习仍然较少.

blocks.en:
Consistent with Stage 1 of our experiments, EWC with Tülu for parameter importance estimation keeps the drop in the general average close to zero.
With only the Tülu subset, EWC limits the drop to − 1.7 -1.7 for Spanish and − 0.7 -0.7 for Arabic, far smaller than the − 3.6 -3.6 to − 13.8 -13.8 drops of other methods.
This mirrors the Stage 1 pattern for EWC, now under bidirectional translation with a stronger base model.
LoRA, Merge, and SPD all show moderate retention of the general average.
blocks.zh:
与我们试验的第一阶段一致,EWC和Tülu的参数重要性估计使共同平均数的下降接近于零。
由于只有Tülu子集,EWC将西班牙语的下降限制在1.7-1.7,阿拉伯语的下降限制在0.7-0.7,远远小于其他方法的下降-3.6-3.6至13.8-13.8。
这个镜像了EWC的阶段1模式,现在在双向翻译下有一个更强大的基础模型.
LoRA, Merge, 和SPD 都显示共同海损保持适度。

blocks.en: 6.3.2 Forgetting of MT-IF Capabilities
blocks.zh: 6.3.2 忘记MT-IF能力

blocks.en:
We observe that while general capabilities have been preserved strongly or moderately by specific methods, such as EWC, this is not the case for MT-IF (i.e., Formality Control, Grammatical Gender Control, Length Control) (see Figure 3 ).
Standard SFT drops the average MT-IF score by − 38.8 -38.8 for Spanish (71.1 → \rightarrow 32.3) and − 37.8 -37.8 for Arabic (66.8 → \rightarrow 28.9).
The only methods that separate from the large cluster around this baseline are SPD, with drops of − 17.8 -17.8 for Spanish and − 27.1 -27.1 for Arabic, and Data Mixing with MT-IF data (using the same prompts as evaluation), ranging from − 4.1 -4.1 to − 25.6 -25.6 for Spanish and from − 11.7 -11.7 to − 15.0 -15.0 for Arabic.
The Arabic mix containing only formality data, a control task that is not part of the Arabic MT-IF average, even underperforms SFT by 4.6 points.
blocks.zh:
我们注意到,虽然一般能力通过具体方法,如EWC得到有力或中度的保护,但MT-IF(即形式控制、语法性别控制、长度控制)的情况并非如此(见图3)。
标准SFT将MT-IF的平均比分减少−38.8-38.8,西班牙语(71.1 →\右翼32.3),阿拉伯语(66.8 →\右翼28.9)的比分减少−37.8-37.8.
与这一基线周围的大型集群分开的唯一方法是SPD,西班牙语的下降幅度为17.8-17.8,阿拉伯语的下降幅度为27.1-27.1,以及数据与MT-IF数据混合(使用与评价相同的提示),西班牙语的下降幅度为4.1-4.1至25.6-25.6,阿拉伯语的下降幅度为11.7-11.7至15.0-15.0。
阿拉伯语组合只包含形式数据,这一控制任务不属于阿拉伯语MT-IF平均值,甚至表现不佳的SFT为4.6分.

blocks.en:
Although EWC retains general capabilities best, it falls into the cluster around the SFT baseline on MT-IF (see Figure 3 ).
EWC with the 10k Tülu subset, the configuration with the smallest drop in the general average for both languages, reaches MT-IF averages of 35.3 for Spanish and 32.7 for Arabic, close to standard SFT (32.3 and 28.9).
Estimating parameter importance on additional MT-IF data does not change this: the general average drops further while the MT-IF averages stay near the SFT baseline.
blocks.zh:
虽然环境WC保留的一般能力最好,但它属于MT-IFT基线的集群(见图3)。
EWC 与 10k Tülu子集是两种语言共同平均数下降最小的配置,西班牙语的MT-IF平均数为35.3,阿拉伯语为32.7,接近标准的SFT(32.3和28.9).
估计更多MT-IF数据的参数重要性不会改变这一点:在MT-IF平均数接近SFT基线时,共同平均数进一步下降。

blocks.en:
We observe that Data Mixing with MT-IF data is the only method that retains most of the MT-IF capabilities (see Figure 3 ).
However, this mitigation is limited to the specific MT-IF task that is included in the training data.
For example, Data Mixing with Tülu (800) + Gender (800) is only actively improving on grammatical gender control capabilities (to 77.9% accuracy vs. standard SFT’s 17.8%), while showing more forgetting than standard SFT on Formality Control (53.7% accuracy vs. 56.1%) and Length Control ( Table 19 ).
This shows that the retention of MT-IF capabilities is limited to the specific task that is included in the training data, and does not transfer to other MT-IF tasks.
On the mixed-in task itself, scores surpass even the base model in all cases except German formality control.
blocks.zh:
我们注意到,将数据与MT-IF数据混合是保留大多数MT-IF能力的唯一方法(见图3)。
然而,这种缓解仅限于培训数据中所包含的具体MT-IF任务。
例如,与Tülu(800)+Gender(800)的数据混合只是正在积极提高语法性别控制能力(精确度为77.9%,标准SFT为17.8%),同时在形式控制(53.7%准确度与56.1%)和长度控制(表19)方面表现出比标准SFT更多的遗忘。
这表明,MT-IF能力的保留仅限于培训数据所包含的具体任务,而不转移到其他MT-IF任务.
在混合任务本身上,除德国形式控制外,所有情况下的得分甚至都超过了基准模型.

blocks.en: However, we observe clear differences between using the same prompt as during evaluation and different prompts in Spanish training runs (see Figure 3 for the dashed-edge markers that distinguish these variants). Evidently, for Data Mixing with different Formality Control Prompts, Formality scores reduce to an average accuracy of 53.8, which is even lower than the score of standard SFT (56.1). The recovery of MT-IF capabilities with Data Mixing is thus partially because of prompt memorization, rather than general MT-IF capability retention.
blocks.zh: 然而,我们发现,在西班牙的训练中,使用与评价时相同的速率和不同的速率之间有明显的区别(区分这些变体的破碎边缘标记见图3)。 显然,对于不同形式控制提示的数据混合,形式性分数降低到平均精度53.8,甚至低于标准SFT(56.1)的分数. 因此,MT-IF能力与Data Mixing的恢复部分是由于即时记忆,而不是一般MT-IF能力的保留.

blocks.en:
Per-method scores are in Tables 18 , 22 and 17 (Appendix).
Standard SFT reduces grammatical gender control scores in both training runs and formality control scores in the Spanish run by more than 30 points.
The majority of methods (CC, EAFT, Freeze, KL, LoRA, STM) stay close to these scores on both tasks.
SPD and Merge stay above these scores on both tasks.
On the training language pair, SPD retains more in the Spanish run (38.5 versus 23.4 for Merge on gender control, 72.0 versus 61.0 on formality control), while Merge retains more gender control in the Arabic run (34.3 versus 29.7).
blocks.zh:
每个方法的分数在表18,22和17(附录)中.
标准SFT在训练运行和形式性控制分数中将西班牙语运行时的语法性别控制分数减少30分以上.
大多数方法(CC、EAFT、Freeze、KL、LORA、STM)在两项任务中都接近这些分数。
SPD和合并在这两个任务中都保持高于这些分数.
在培训语言对口方面,SPD在西班牙语运行中保留较多(在性别控制方面为38.5比23.4,在形式控制方面为72.0比61.0),而在阿拉伯语运行方面为34.3比29.7保留较多的性别控制。

blocks.en:
Per-method length control scores are in Tables 19 and 21 (Appendix).
The base model follows shorter and longer instructions relatively well.
After standard SFT, compliance collapses and the tgt/src ratios of the three control settings converge; almost every other method stays within this range.
SPD is the only method that keeps compliance with both instructions clearly above the SFT level.
While EWC (Tülu 10k) also partially follows the longer-translation instruction, its COMET scores under this instruction drop to 74.3 for Spanish and 71.1 for Arabic, well below other methods.
This suggests that EWC pushes the model toward producing longer sequences without ensuring correctness of translations.
blocks.zh:
每方法长度控制分数载于表19和表21(附录)。
基准模型遵循较短和较长的指令的情况相对较好。
在标准SFT之后,遵守崩溃和三种控制设置的tgt/src比率趋同;几乎所有其他方法都留在这个范围内.
SPD是唯一能使两种指令都明显高于SFT水平的方法.
虽然EWC(Tülu 10k)也部分遵循了较长的翻译指令,但该指令下的COMET分数下降到西班牙语74.3分,阿拉伯语71.1分,远低于其他方法.
这表明,EWC将模型推向产生更长的序列,而不保证翻译的正确性.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Normalized layer-wise Fisher importance on Llama 3.1 8B Instruct, estimated on Tülu, MT-IF data, and their combination. The importance profiles largely coincide.
blocks.zh: 图4: Llama 的渔业重要性 8B 指令,根据Tülu,MT-IF数据及其组合估算. 重要性简介大致吻合。

blocks.en: 7 Analysis and Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 分析和讨论

blocks.en:
Figure 4 speaks against the simplest cause, a Fisher estimated on Tülu that misses the parameters behind MT-IF: the normalized layer-wise Fisher importance of the three anchor datasets used in Stage 2 has nearly the same profile, with most importance in layers 0–5 and the final layer (parameter-level differences remain possible).
Consistent with this, a Fisher estimated on MT-IF data alone did not preserve MT-IF in the Spanish run (average 34.8 versus 32.3 for standard SFT) and lowered the general average (58.1 versus 65.1 with the Tülu Fisher).
We therefore attribute the asymmetry to the MT gradients rather than to the importance estimate.
EWC with the Tülu Fisher reaches the same COMET as standard SFT (87.0) while keeping the general average at 65.1 versus 55.8, which is only possible if MT fine-tuning updates the parameters behind the general benchmarks weakly.
The MT-IF controls, in contrast, are exercised on translation inputs, so the parameters that carry them receive the MT gradient throughout fine-tuning, which a fixed quadratic penalty does not hold back.
We did not measure per-parameter drift, so this explanation remains a hypothesis.
blocks.zh:
图4说明了最简单的原因,一位费舍尔在图卢上估计,它错过了MT-IF背后的参数:第2阶段所使用的三个锚地数据集的正常分层渔业重要性几乎相同,在第0至第5层和最后一层最为重要(参数级差异仍然是可能的)。
因此,仅根据MT-IF数据估算的一位Fisher没有在西班牙运行时保留MT-IF,(标准SFT平均为34.8比32.3)并降低了共同平均水平(Tülu Fisher为58.1比65.1)。
因此,我们把不对称归因于MT梯度,而不是重要性估计。
EWC与Tülu Fisher号达到与标准SFT(87.0)相同的彗星,同时将共同平均值保持在65.1对55.8,这只有在MT微调弱地更新一般基准背后的参数时才有可能.
与此相反,MT-IF控制是在翻译输入上执行的,因此,携带它们的参数在整个微调过程中都会得到MT梯度,固定的四极惩罚不会阻滞.
我们没有测量每个参数的漂移,所以这个解释仍然是一个假设.

blocks.en:
The methods in this group (KL, STM, CC, EAFT) compute their constraint on the MT training batches ( Section 3.2 ), so they bound the drift only on inputs on which the model must change and leave the evaluated behavior unconstrained.
KL regularization, for instance, penalizes divergence from the base model on the translation inputs themselves and places no constraint on the prompts used by the general benchmarks or the MT-IF evaluations.
CC additionally masks almost nothing on MT data.
In the Spanish 8B run (X=0.25), each condition alone is met by roughly a quarter of the tokens in a batch (on average 2773 with low entropy and 2619 with low probability), but fewer than one token per batch (0.36) meets both.
Tokens that are improbable under the base model are thus uncertain rather than confidently wrong, and with almost no tokens masked, CC reduces to standard SFT, in line with its scores in Table 2 .
blocks.zh:
这个组中的方法(KL,STM,CC,EAFT)计算出它们对MT训练批次(第3.2节)的限制,因此它们只将漂移限制在模型必须改变的输入上,使被评价的行为不受限制.
例如,KL规范化惩罚了在翻译投入本身上与基准模式的差别,对一般基准或MT-IF评价所用的提示没有限制。
CC在MT数据上几乎没有任何遮盖.
在西班牙8B跑(X=0.25)中,每个条件单靠一个批次中约四分之一的符符(平均2773个有低 en,2619个有低概率)满足,但每批次不到一个符(0.36)满足两者.
因此,在基模下不可能用的托肯不确定而不是自信地错误,在几乎没有符号蒙面的情况下,CC按照它在表2中的分数降低到标准SFT.

blocks.en:
Among the methods without auxiliary data, only SPD separates from the SFT cluster on MT-IF (average drops of 17.8 for Spanish and 27.1 for Arabic, against 38.8 and 37.8 for standard SFT), plausibly because its penalty applies per tensor and step, when the update heads toward a higher-loss region, rather than following a fixed importance estimate.
Our results do not isolate this mechanism, and the retained scores remain well below those of data mixing.
blocks.zh:
在没有辅助数据的方法中,只有SPD从MT-IF上的SFT集群中分离出来(西班牙语平均下降17.8,阿拉伯语平均下降27.1,标准SFT下降38.8和37.8),这很合理,因为它的处罚适用于一个更高损失区域,而不是遵循一个固定的重要性估计。
我们的结果并不孤立这一机制,保留得分仍然远远低于数据混合得分。

blocks.en:
Methods anchored to the base model parameters assume that the fine-tuning task does not need to update the weights that carry the capability to be preserved.
Under MT fine-tuning this holds for general capabilities but not for MT-IF, which is itself translation behavior.
Data mixing escapes this limit by continuing to train the control rather than constraining the model, but as the Spanish formality run shows, the retention is tied to the training prompt.
blocks.zh:
以基准模型参数为基础的方法假设,微调任务不需要更新具有保留能力的权重。
在MT的微调下,一般能力就属于这种情况,而MT-IF则不属于这种情况,而MT-IF本身就是翻译行为。
数据混合通过继续训练控制器而不是限制模型来逃避这一限制,但正如西班牙形式运行所显示的,保留与训练时速挂钩.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
We compared forgetting mitigation methods anchored to auxiliary data, to model outputs, and to the base model parameters, for fine-tuning Llama 3.2 1B Instruct and Llama 3.1 8B Instruct on parallel data for three language pairs.
EWC retains general capabilities best on both models. On the 8B model, it limits the drop in the general average to 1.7 points for Spanish and 0.7 for Arabic, against 11.0 and 8.3 for standard fine-tuning.
Its scores for formality and grammatical gender control nevertheless remain close to those of standard fine-tuning, even when the data used to estimate parameter importance includes control-task examples.
Of the methods compared, only mixing control-task examples into the training data preserves the corresponding control, and the effect does not extend to other control tasks or to unseen prompts for the same task.
Among the methods without control-task data, SPD retains the most MT-IF, at scores well below data mixing.
blocks.zh:
我们比较了基于辅助数据、模型输出和基准模型参数的忘却减缓方法,以微调Llama 3.2 1B Instruct和Llama 3.1 8B, 指导三种语言对的平行数据。
EWC保留了两种模式上最好的一般能力. 在8B型机车上,将通用平均降幅限制在西班牙语1.7分,阿拉伯语0.7分,而标准微调为11.0分和8.3分.
其形式性和语法性别控制的分数仍然接近标准微调的分数,即使用于估计参数重要性的数据包括控制任务的例子。
在比较的方法中,只有将控制-任务实例混合到培训数据中,才能保存相应的控制,效果不会延伸到其他控制任务或隐形提示相同任务.
在没有控制任务数据的方法中,SPD保留最多的MT-IF,分数远低于数据混合.

blocks.en: We conclude that retention on general benchmarks does not establish that MT-specific instruction following is preserved. Evaluations of MT fine-tuning should measure the controls the application requires, and preserving them currently requires matching data in the training mix. Open questions are whether broader control-task data, for example synthetic examples covering more tasks and prompt variants, can preserve MT-IF without overfitting to the seen prompts, and whether the findings extend to further controls such as glossary constraints and gender-neutral translation.
blocks.zh: 我们的结论是,在一般基准上保留,并不能确定后面的MT特定指示得到保留。 对MT微调的评价应衡量应用程序所需的控制,目前保留这些控制需要培训组合中的匹配数据。 开放的问题是,更广泛的控制-任务数据,例如涵盖更多任务和即时变体的合成实例,是否能够在不过分适应可见的提示的情况下保留MT-IF,以及这些结论是否延伸到诸如词汇限制和性别中立翻译等进一步控制。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Our comparison is restricted to SFT-based adaptation and does not include on-policy reinforcement learning or preference optimization.
As discussed in Section 2 , recent prior work showed that on-policy methods retain prior capabilities better than SFT.
Including them would have required model-generated trajectories and task-specific rewards or preference pairs, a substantial addition to our framework that would complicate a fair comparison.
blocks.zh:
我们的比较仅限于基于SFT的适应,不包括政策强化学习或优化偏好。
正如第2节所讨论的那样,最近的前期工作显示,政策方法比SFT更好地保留了以前的能力。
将它们包括在内将需要模型产生的轨迹和针对具体任务的奖励或优待,这是对我们框架的重大补充,将使公平比较复杂化。

blocks.en:
We adapt the evaluation for MT-IF from related work and inherit some limitations.
For control of formality and grammatical gender, we follow the evaluation approaches proposed in CoCoA-MT and MT-GenEval.
These rely on predefined marked phrases and words and some translation variants may be missed.
MT-GenEval’s masculine/feminine annotation, which our prompts follow, treats gender as binary and excludes non-binary referents.
We use it because its scoring is deterministic and cheap to run, whereas gender-neutral translation currently requires a trained classifier or an LLM judge for evaluation ( Savoldi et al., 2025 ) .
Our results therefore cover the selection between masculine and feminine forms and do not show whether MT fine-tuning degrades gender-neutral translation.
The MT-IF evaluation also covers only translation from English into Spanish, German, and Arabic, where CoCoA-MT and MT-GenEval provide data, and formality control only for Spanish and German.
The length-control score compares each instructed translation with the model’s own uninstructed translation, so it measures whether the instruction changed the output length and not whether a length target was met.
blocks.zh:
我们根据相关工作调整了MT-IF的评价,并继承了一些局限性。
为了控制形式性和语法性别,我们遵循CoCoA-MT和MT-GenEval提出的评价方法。
这些依赖于预定义的标记短语和词,一些翻译变体可能会被忽略.
MT-GenEval的男性/女性注释,
我们之所以使用它,是因为它的评分是决定性的和廉价的,而不分性别的翻译目前需要经过培训的分类员或LLM法官进行评价(Savoldi等人,2025年)。
因此,我们的结果包括了男性和女性形式的选择,没有显示MT微调是否降低性别中性翻译。
MT-IF评价还只涵盖从英文译成西班牙文、德文和阿拉伯文,CoCoA-MT和MT-GenEval提供数据,形式控制只涉及西班牙文和德文。
长度控制分数将每个指令翻译与模型自己的未指令翻译相比较,因此它衡量指令是否改变了输出长度,而不是是否达到了长度目标.

blocks.en:
Model size, translation directions, and data source change together between Stage 1 and Stage 2, and the configurations selected on the 1B model are only slightly re-tuned for the 8B model.
The design therefore does not show which of these factors causes the larger forgetting of standard SFT at 8B or the reversal for STM, and the Stage 2 configurations may not be optimal for the larger model.
We only use data from our internal standard data preparation pipeline which may introduce some biases.
Experiments are further limited to two model sizes of the Llama 3 family and to unidirectional and bidirectional translation of English and three target languages (two high and one low-resource).
While we assume that our findings generalize to other languages and models, this is still untested.
blocks.zh:
模型大小,翻译方向,和数据源在第一阶段和第二阶段之间一起变化,在1B模型上选择的配置仅对8B模型稍作调整.
因此,设计没有显示其中哪些因素导致在8B时更大规模地忘记标准SFT或STM的倒置,阶段2配置对于更大的模型来说可能并不理想.
我们只使用我们内部标准数据编制流程中的数据,这可能带来一些偏差。
实验进一步限于Llama 3家族的两个模型大小,以及英语和三种目标语言的单向和双向翻译(两种高语言和一种低资源语言).
虽然我们假设我们的结论通通到其他语言和模式,但这仍未经过检验。

blocks.en: A.1 Information on Training Data

blocks.en: The MT training data consists of two groups. Base comprises sentence-level parallel segments drawn from OPUS and other sources.
